name: Märchen Paradise
original_name: メルヘン・パラダイス
source:
Main character is a high school student who peeked inside a suspiciously looking pipe and got warped  into a fairy-tale world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名高中生朝一根看起来很可疑的管道里窥探，竟被传送进童话世界。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
